decisions.decision: Confirm original r=-.75 only. Finucane et al2000 full primary title/authors/journal/DOI match; Study2 p11 and Exhibit6 explicitly identify correlation of manipulated versus unmanipulated risk/benefit t-values across12 technology-by-information-condition aggregate points. Source raw glyph is y-diaeresis before.75, with same paragraph explicitly predicting and describing an inverse association. Transcribe minus as the blind source extraction and independent review do; no arithmetic conversion or global OCR/parser alias. This is not a participant-level correlation. Nearby nuclear-power pre/post t p-bounds are different tests; no p-value invented. Participant count inconsistencies and all other fields preserved.

Retain requested f-squared metric hold. Unique clarity-by-rating-distribution desirability interaction prints unstandardized beta=-.146,p=.022; R2=.039,F(3,372)=5.038 describe the whole three-term model. Reviewer reconstructs MSE/SE/t from rounded condition means/SDs and assumes -1/+1 coding, then calculates t-squared/df. Neither requested f-squared nor that derivation is documented in es_repr_r (null). Do not confirm merely by reproducing stored value, infer predictor coding from slopes, or equate whole-model and local effect sizes. Existing metric gates retain this hold; no new delegate or code/alias/conversion. All N/p/author/original fields frozen.
